purpose: Test whether the already-merged exact R5 OR-lift/restriction residual DAG can rescue canonical C025 OPEN formulas to replay-clean UNSAT on fresh, construction-certified UNSAT families without changing R5 runtime semantics.

benchmark_truth_boundary.independent_certificate_method: enumerate the small combinatorial object assignment space (3^4 = 81 assignments) for the frozen unsatisfiable construction; do not call C025, R5, a SAT library, or any solver routing primitive during benchmark truth certification

PHP_4_INTO_3.logical_structure: 4 pigeons must each occupy at least one of 3 holes; no two pigeons may occupy the same hole
PHP_4_INTO_3.CNF: four width-3 at-least-one clauses plus eighteen binary pairwise collision clauses
PHP_4_INTO_3.UNSAT_certificate: enumerate all 3^4 pigeon-to-hole functions and verify every assignment has a collision
PHP_4_INTO_3.variant_rule: seeded bijection from the 12 logical occupancy atoms to numeric variable IDs 1..12; clause semantics unchanged

K4_THREE_COLOR.CNF: four width-3 at-least-one-color clauses, twelve per-vertex at-most-one-color binary clauses, eighteen edge same-color exclusion binary clauses
K4_THREE_COLOR.UNSAT_certificate: enumerate all 3^4 vertex colorings and verify every coloring gives equal colors to at least one K4 edge
K4_THREE_COLOR.variant_rule: seeded bijection from the 12 logical vertex-color atoms to numeric variable IDs 1..12; clause semantics unchanged

outer_ecology.canonical_UNSAT: preserve replay-confirmed canonical result; R5 not invoked
outer_ecology.canonical_OPEN: invoke unchanged merged R5 from original CNF
outer_ecology.R5_UNSAT: credit only after unchanged R5 decisive receipt replay reports UNSAT
outer_ecology.R5_OPEN: remain OPEN; no negative inference beyond this frozen scope

gate.strict_UNSAT_rescue_required_for_PASS: at least one formula with canonical status OPEN must become replay-clean R5 UNSAT
